Backend: 33/33 pytest cases pass including new TestPayroll (6 cases: generate-all, filter, INSS progressive-bracket verification against highest-salary emp, single generate with bonus/benefits/other_discounts + idempotency, employee role 403, employee sees only own) and TestPerformance (4 cases: seeded cycle present, create cycle + evaluation with overall=mean(entrega,qualidade,colab)=4.0 and nine_box label='Estrela' for perf=5/pot=5 plus 'Risco / atenção' for perf=1/pot=1, idempotent replace on same cycle+emp, employee 403 on both /api/evaluations and /api/eval-cycles). Frontend: /folha admin flow — competência input, 'Gerar para todos' generates 8 rows, table shows Jun/2026 proventos/descontos/líquido, view-payslip-* modal shows Construa RH header, PROVENTOS (Salário base), DESCONTOS (INSS, IRRF), FGTS depósito and Imprimir/PDF button. /desempenho — 'Avaliar colaborador' dialog opens, employee select lists 8 options, save-eval persists and the Nine Box matrix + evaluation list render the employee in the correct cell (verified Ana Beatriz Lima = Mantenedor P:M/D:M). /meus-holerites — Carlos Eduardo Silva sees exactly 1 payslip (his own, R$ 9.281,30 líquido) and modal opens with full breakdown. Role nav enforcement verified: employee only sees Meu Painel/Bater Ponto/Minhas Férias/Meus Holerites.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` on DialogContent — accessibility only, non-blocking

action_items: (nice-to-have) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to the Holerite and Avaliar-colaborador DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning
critical_code_review_comments: build_payslip stores employee_name as snapshot — good for historical immutability; employee rename won't retroactively change payslips.
/api/payslips/generate and generate-all are correctly idempotent (delete_one by employee_id+competencia before insert).
nine_box labels dictionary keyed as (pot_level, perf_level) and lookup uses (t, p) — matches; verified via 'Estrela' and 'Risco / atenção' assertions.

/api/payslips GET currently does NOT verify that employee role is only querying their own employee_id — an employee could pass any employee_id to see other payslips. Backend returns all matching regardless of role. UI mitigates by scoping to user.employee_id but API itself is not enforced. Consider adding: if user.role=='employee' then force employee_id=user.employee_id.
Same note for /api/evaluations and /api/attendance list endpoints — no row-level scoping for employee role.
